description: One case per toggle: the estate with proofFilesStayHot on and nothing else. The known answer is F-PROOF-HOT-TIER, the Finding of Check PROOF-HOT-TIER, whose severity (Low) and fix are the Check's. The narration must name that problem and no other.

setup.toggle: proofFilesStayHot, switched on alone from the fixed estate: infra/as-found.ps1 fixed, then infra/as-found.ps1 proofFilesStayHot=true

input: Run an Estate health check and tell me what you found.

explanation.rubric: Says the health check found a problem matching: Proof of delivery files stay in the hot tier. Does not report any other problem, and does not say the estate is healthy.
